title: Selecting 'wait here (leaves the party for now)' in a companion dialogue menu actually removes them from the party mid-conversation, which reads as a continuation option rather than a dismissal — cost a wasted turn re-recruiting Tamsin.
where: companion dialogue menus, e.g. The Forge / Tamsin

evidence.quote: Selecting 'wait here (leaves the party for now)' in a companion dialogue menu actually removes them from the party mid-conversation, which reads as a continuation option rather than a dismissal — cost a wasted turn re-recruiting Tamsin.
